Example blavaan fitted object

Source: R/data.R
tma.IRT.fitted.model.Rd

A fitted blavaan object from a unidimensional two-parameter IRT model, included as example data for demonstrating BayesIRTplot().

Usage

tma.IRT.fitted.model

Format

A fitted model object of class blavaan.

Source

Item Response Warehouse: https://itemresponsewarehouse.org/data.html

Details

The model was fit using the blavaan package, using a subset of the publicly available dataset “tma” from Item Response Warehouse.

References

Taylor, J. A. (1953). A personality scale of manifest anxiety. The Journal of Abnormal and Social Psychology, 48(2), 285-290. https://doi.org/10.1037/h0056264

Datapages. (2026). Item Response Warehouse (Version 43.0), tma [Table]. Redivis (DOI:10.71778/V2DW-7A53). https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/as2e-cv7jb41fd/tables/hd62-026kwagr9?v=43.0

Examples

BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model)
